content: Root cause: The bug was caused by insufficient locking mechanisms around the shared descriptor list used by multiple transmit queues in the SYSTEMPORT hardware. This led to concurrent access issues where multiple producers could modify the descriptor list simultaneously, resulting in corrupted descriptors. Specifically, the hardware could operate on incorrect packet lengths and checksums due to race conditions when writing to the WRITE_PORT_{HI,LO} registers, as the existing locking only protected access within a single transmit queue rather than across all queues.
